scope: internal native-space typography calibration; not a public project schema

provenance.baseline_reproduction: Four archived cases reproduced exactly in the local environment

system_font.value: Public system UI font plus bold symbolic trait; default optical behavior

origin_x.provenance: Retained v1 registration prior; not an exact native layout box

paragraph_width.qualification: 983 and 991 tested; width and wrapping remain underidentified

latin_size.unit: requested Core Text size in native raster coordinates
latin_size.qualification: At width 987; exclusion range 104.25–104.5, with one held-out wrapping failure

japanese_size.qualification: Separate case optima 102 and 103; no universal script-specific correction adopted

mixed_alignment.qualification: Observed state only; selection rule unknown

first_baseline.qualification: Case-balanced ordinary Latin proxy fit at size 104.5; conservative empirical investigation band, not a confidence interval

line_advance.qualification: Proxy fit across four Latin cases; not a native universal line or paragraph spacing rule

source_break_semantics.qualification: S04B, S09, and S10 preserve observed boundaries as explicit input constraints

japanese_state_effect.qualification: State or local fallback differences are competing explanations; neither isolated

investigation_bands.qualification: Observed extraction sensitivity and case spread; not final fidelity acceptance thresholds

disposition.next_gate: state-controlled Japanese typography and English wrapping refinement
